title: Arc modular sofa
description: A low, generous silhouette with rounded arms, deep seats and a quietly recessed walnut base. Arc is designed around the way you actually live: feet up, book open, everyone welcome.

materials.value: Linen, bouclé or wool · walnut base

title: Vale lounge chair
description: A sculpted timber frame cradles a softly upholstered seat. Small in footprint, generous in comfort. Vale brings a little warmth to the space between everything else.

images.alt: Vale lounge chair — original Atelier Blender study

featured_image.alt: Vale lounge chair — original Atelier Blender study

title: Miro dining chair
description: An open, curved back and a softly upholstered seat, grounded by a solid oak frame. A dining chair with no hurry to leave the table.

title: Monolith coffee table
description: Honed travertine, softened at every edge. Two sculptural supports carry a pill-shaped top; natural mineral variation makes each piece its own.

images.alt: Monolith coffee table — original Atelier Blender study

featured_image.alt: Monolith coffee table — original Atelier Blender study

title: Trestle dining table
description: Long lines, softened corners and a solid oak surface that welcomes the marks of a life well lived. A balanced frame keeps the space underneath beautifully open.

title: Silo side table
description: A fluted cylinder in warm walnut, finished with a smooth round top. A place for the book, the glass, the small things that make a room yours.

title: Line console
description: An exceptionally slender oak console with a calm, architectural profile. A grounding line in an entrance, behind a sofa or along a quiet wall.

title: Lumen floor lamp
description: A pleated linen shade, a slender bronze stem and a low weighted base. Warm, diffused light that changes the feeling of a room without taking it over.

images.alt: Lumen floor lamp — original Atelier Blender study

featured_image.alt: Lumen floor lamp — original Atelier Blender study

title: Halo pendant
description: A softly rounded paper form that floats above a table or in a quiet corner. The shade turns a single point of light into an atmosphere.

title: Pebble table lamp
description: Two smooth ceramic forms meet in a softly balanced table lamp. A warm pool of light for bedsides, shelves and unhurried evenings.

title: Arc ottoman
description: A softly upholstered extension of the Arc family. Pull it close, move it aside, give the room another way to work.

title: The material library
description: Six generous fabric swatches to see in your light and feel in your hands. Includes natural linen, textured bouclé and soft wool in our considered palette.
